chapter.verse: Ka ta aw, na lawmte khatpeuh in sum leitawi a lak ciangin, a loh zawh kei leh ama taangin a lohsak dingin kam na ciam kha hiam?
Na kampauna hangin nang hong kimanin, na thuciamna hangin na awk kha hiam?
Ka ta aw, tua bang na hih khak leh, tua mipa khut sungah a om na hi hi; na suahtak theih nadingin manlangin ama kiangah pai in la, hong khah nadingin ama kiangah thuum in.
Ihmu mu kei in la, om mawkmawk kei in.
Sabengpa’ kiang panin a suahtak nadingin sakhi a tai bangin, thang ah a awk vasa a kitom bangin na suahtak nadingin hamciam in.
Thadahpa aw, miksite kiangah pai in la, amau’ nuntakna zia va en in.
Amaute in a uk ding leh a makai ding kuamah nei lo napi-in,
khuakhal sungin a nek ding uh, tuk sungin kaikhawm khol uh hi.
Thadahpa aw, bang tanvei lumlum ding a, cik ciangin thokhia ding na hi hiam?
Tawmkhat sung mengme lai ning, tawmkhat sung ihmu lai ning, na cih kikalin,
zawn’na leh cihmawhna in migilo gutate bangin nang hong sugawp pak ding hi.
Mi gina lo, a gilopa, zuauthu genin vak kawikawi a,
nang hong khem nop manin, a mit-heek hong pia-in, a khe tawh hong su-in, a khut tawh hong khoih hi.
A lungsim-ah thusia bekbek ngaihsun niloh a, a omna peuh-ah buaina piangsak hi.
Tua ahih manin theihkholh lohin ama tungah lungkhamna tung ding a, bawlkik zawh nawn loh dongin siatna ngah ding hi.
Topa in a muhdah, a khahkhong ngei loh ding, thu guk, bek hilo, thu sagih tak om a tuate in,
kihihsakna, zuauthu genna, mawhnei lo mi thahna,
thusia bawl ding ngaihsutna, gamtat siat ding a manlangte,
zuauthu a ban gengen teci man lote, a lawmte lakah kitotna a piangsakte ahi hi.
Ka ta aw, na pa’ hong gen bangin gamta in la, na nu’ hong thuhilhte mangngilh ngei kei in.
Amau’ hong thugente phawk tawntung in la, na lungsimah ciamteh niloh in.
Tua thute in na paina peuhah lam hong lak ding a, zan-in na ihmut kalin nang hong cing ding a, sun-in na hah sungin na gamtat nading hong hilh ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh thupiaknate in meivak hi a, hilhnate in a taang mahmah khuavak bang hi-in, khalna leh hilhnate in nuntak nading lampi hi a,
Mi’ zi tawh na mawh loh nading nang hong kemin, kamkhum zanga hong zol numei ginalote kiang panin hong hu ding hi.
Amau’ meel hoihna iplah kha kei in la, amau’ hong zawlmitna khenglah kei in.
Bang hang hiam cih leh anlum khat tawh numei paktat khat kingah zo a, ahi zongin numei tawh mawhna in nuntakna bup siasak hi.
Na ang sungah meikuang pom lecin, na puan kang loin om ding ahi hiam?
Mei-am tung tawnin pai lecin, na khe kang loin om ding ahi hiam?
Tua mah bangin, mi zi tawh a mawhte in thuak ding a, tua banga gamta peuhmah in thuak ding uh hi.
A gilkial mi khat in an a guk ciangin, midangte in mawhsak lua lo napi,
amah kiman leh, azah sagih-in kiloh sak a, a neih khempeuh a piak kul hi.
Ahi zongin numei tawh mawhte in thu ngaihsun thei lo mi hi a, amah leh amah a kisusia tawm ahi hi.
Amah in satgawpna thuakin a min sia ding a, a mindai paisuak ding hi.
A pasal a heh zawk nading thudang om nawn lo a, a heh thukna-ah khawl hun cih nei thei lo ding hi.
Amah in sum-le-pai sang nuam lo a, letsong tampi piakna in a hehna damsak zo lo hi.
